[PREFERENCE] User is looking for lactose-free alternatives to their favorite foods.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided suggestions for lactose-free alternatives, including:  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] - Non-dairy milk options: Almond milk, soy milk, cashew milk, oat milk, coconut milk, and lactose-free milk.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] - Yogurt alternatives: Soy yogurt, coconut yogurt, almond yogurt.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] - Cheese alternatives: Vegan cheese, lactose-free cheese, hard cheeses like Swiss or cheddar, and nutritional yeast.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] - Other lactose-free alternatives: Ice cream options (coconut milk, cashew, banana-based), vegan butter, and non-dairy creamers.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant advised to read labels, experiment with brands, and consider making homemade alternatives.  
[USER] User found the suggestions helpful and asked for specific brands or flavors of lactose-free ice cream.

[USER] User mentioned feeling tired and inquired if lactose intolerance could be contributing to their fatigue.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant explained that fatigue can be a symptom of lactose intolerance but also related to the user's recent cold and sinus infection.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant listed potential causes of fatigue related to lactose intolerance and other factors, including:  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] - Gut inflammation, nutrient deficiencies, hormonal imbalance.
